jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Manager
jobs.description:
**Marketing \& Communications Manager \-** FamilyWell Health \& FamilyWell Academy


**Location:** Remote


**Department:** Marketing \& Communications


**Reports To:** Head of Growth Operations


**Job Type:** Part\-Time, Contract, up to 25–30 hours per week (with potential path to full\-time)


**Compensation:** $55–$70/hr depending on experience


**Scope:** Supports both FamilyWell Health (clinical/B2B) and FamilyWell Academy (D2C/partnerships/education)


**About FamilyWell Health**
---------------------------



FamilyWell Health is an AI\-enabled mental health startup dedicated to addressing the women's mental health crisis by seamlessly embedding high\-quality, equitable, and affordable mental health care into women's health practices and health systems. Our comprehensive virtual care model delivers evidence\-based mental health services across the full reproductive lifecycle, from fertility through menopause, using the proven Collaborative Care Model (CoCM).



Our AI\-enabled platform integrates coaching, therapy, psychiatry, and care coordination services directly into clinical workflows, making mental health care accessible, affordable, and insurance\-covered. With 95% of patients experiencing clinical improvement within four months, FamilyWell is addressing one of healthcare's most underserved areas while building a financially sustainable model for provider partners.



Following our recent Series A raise, we are expanding nationally and seeking exceptional leaders to join our mission\-driven team. Learn more at www.familywellhealth.com.


**Role Summary**
================



FamilyWell is looking for a hands\-on Marketing \& Communications Manager who can move fluidly between clinical credibility and consumer resonance. This is not a role for someone who delegates execution — you will write the copy, build the sequences, design the assets, and own the strategy behind all of it.



You will be the primary marketing voice for two distinct but connected brands: FamilyWell Health, our clinical care platform serving patients and health system partners, and FamilyWell Academy, our professional training and certification program for perinatal mental health providers. These audiences require different tones, channels, and funnels — and you will navigate both with intention.



You are proactive, not reactive. You look at what the data is telling you and adjust. You use AI as a productivity tool but you can immediately spot the difference between generated filler and writing that actually earns attention. You produce the latter.


**What You Will Own**
=====================


**Content Strategy \& Writing (25%)**
-------------------------------------


* Develop and execute a content strategy across both FamilyWell Health and FamilyWell Academy, with distinct voice and audience mapping for each
* Write in a clinical, credible voice for provider\-facing and health system content — white papers, one\-pagers, case studies, and email campaigns
* Write in an accessible, warm consumer voice for patient\-facing and Academy learner content
* Produce blog posts, newsletters, social copy, and nurture email sequences independently — not by prompting AI and publishing the output
* Edit and elevate AI\-assisted drafts with judgment about what reads as genuine versus generated

**HubSpot \& Nurture Marketing (25%)**
--------------------------------------


* Own HubSpot from strategy to execution: build and manage contact lists, segmentation, workflows, and email sequences
* Design and deploy nurture campaigns for multiple audience segments — prospective clinical partners, Academy enrollees, and direct\-to\-consumer patient leads
* Track open rates, click\-through, conversion, and funnel movement; make data\-informed adjustments to cadence, content, and segmentation
* Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to ensure messaging accuracy and compliance with healthcare communication standards

**Website \& Digital Presence (15%)**
-------------------------------------


* Manage and update content on Squarespace for both brands, including landing pages, course pages, and campaign\-specific pages
* Ensure SEO fundamentals are applied across web content
* Maintain a consistent visual and editorial brand across all digital touchpoints

**Design \& Asset Production (15%)**
------------------------------------


* Produce branded visual assets in Canva: social graphics, email headers, event materials, one\-pagers, and provider\-facing educational content
* Manage an organized asset library and maintain brand consistency across both FamilyWell entities
* Support Academy course marketing materials and promotional collateral

**Social Media Planning \& Management (20%)**
---------------------------------------------


* Develop a social media content calendar across LinkedIn and Instagram that serves both brands
* Write and schedule posts; monitor engagement and community signals
* Identify relevant cultural and clinical moments in maternal and perinatal mental health to build timely content around

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================


**Required**
------------


* 5\+ years of marketing and communications experience, with demonstrated B2B and D2C work
* Exceptional writing ability across multiple voices and formats — clinical, consumer, and editorial
* Hands\-on HubSpot experience: you have built workflows, sequences, and reports yourself, based on desired goals.
* Experience managing or editing a website in Squarespace or a comparable CMS
* Comfort with AI writing tools paired with strong editorial judgment — you know when to use them and when to rewrite
* Ability to work independently, set priorities, and surface recommendations without being asked
* Experience analyzing marketing data and translating it into strategic adjustments
* Familiarity with healthcare, mental health, women's health, or a similarly regulated, relationship\-driven sector

**Strongly Preferred**
------

jobs.title: (Seasonal) Executive Producer, Content
jobs.description:
The Krazy Coupon Lady (KCL) is a female\-founder\-owned deal intelligence company — we turn the chaos of sales, coupons, and promo codes into the smartest way for millions of shoppers to save. They come back to us before they buy, and we're hiring the people who'll keep them coming back. We move fast, care deeply about our audience, and believe the best work happens when smart people bring clarity, creativity, and real accountability.

  

You may have noticed that our headquarters are in Boise, ID, but our workforce is fully remote in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, or Wisconsin. All team\-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of U.S. time zones.

**About The Role**
------------------

**This is a seasonal six\-month position with the potential to transition into a full\-time role based on business needs and performance.**

As our Executive Producer, Content, you’ll develop and oversee the execution of new formats, series, and content buckets for our owned and operated platforms, as well as identify and build out emerging media opportunities like Podcasts, Webinars, YouTube Shorts, WhatsApp, Marco Polo, Pinterest, and more. You will inherit and oversee the current sponsored content workflows, optimizing them for maximum results, and collaborate across editorial, social, influencer, and sales teams to create net\-new business opportunities for KCL across all media. This role is equal parts creative, strategic, and operational: you’ll develop cross\-functional playbooks that enable velocity, scale, and opportunity, ensuring collaborating teams can execute with clarity, creativity, and impact.


In a fast\-paced environment, you’ll balance the now and the next: optimizing today’s revenue\-driving content while helping build tomorrow’s audience growth engine through a lens of untapped opportunities that ultimately drive new business and new audiences for KCL. Above all, you’ll champion a content development strategy that attracts, retains, and activates new audiences and strategic partners, while keeping KCL’s voice bold, useful, and


unmistakable.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and develop a high\-performing bench of producers and editors who can independently deliver platform\-native, revenue\-driving content at scale.
* Create new content formats, franchises, and discovery buckets consistently reaching new audiences and driving engagement, advertiser interest, and repeat sponsorship opportunities.
* Identify new and emerging platform opportunities for KCL that ultimately expand and diversify our audience while driving revenue growth.
* Develop and execute platform\-native storytelling that thrives across emerging and established channels, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, WhatsApp, and Marco Polo, with each channel optimized for how audiences naturally consume content.
* Oversee and improve upon sponsored editorial, social video, and integrated campaigns that feel organic to the KCL voice while delivering measurable partner value.
* Identify and own opportunities for webinars, podcasts, and new media initiatives to become scalable sponsorship vehicles with strong audience retention and repeat advertiser investment.
* Develop and oversee scripts, creative concepts, and storytelling that consistently balances brand authenticity, performance metrics, and shopper trust.
* Oversee and execute sponsored campaigns that move seamlessly from concept through execution with strong client satisfaction, performance delivery, and minimal operational friction.
* Consistently present, collaborate, and execute on creative ideas and input that strengthen both proactive and reactive RFP responses, increasing win rates and expanding revenue opportunities.
* Track campaign performance insights that feed continuous improvement\-creating smarter repeatable playbooks.
* Strongly aligned with editorial, social, influencer, marketing, and sales teams leads to integrate content opportunities that drive measurable revenue growth.
* Identify emerging brand partnerships and creator collaborations to expand KCL’s reach and unlock new monetization channels.
* Create a sponsored content strategy that contributes directly to both short\-term revenue targets and long\-term audience growth.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
-----------------------------------

* Consistent audience growth driven by discovery content and platform\-native storytelling.
* Repeatable sponsored content franchises that brands actively seek to participate in.
* Increased content revenue supported by strong advertiser relationships and effective creative execution.
* A scalable, high\-velocity content operation with clear workflows and minimal bottlenecks.
* Innovative partnership solutions, channels, and formats that expand KCL’s revenue, reach and authority.
* Content formats that keep KCL’s voice bold, useful, trusted, and unmistakable.

**Ideal Background**
--------------------

* 10\+ years in content or development leadership at a digital publisher, social commerce platform, or high\-volume media company with experience managing multifunctional remote teams.
* Deep experience developing discovery\-first content strategies across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and Pinterest, with a strong understanding of what drives audience growth, engagement, and monetization.
* Proven track record building scalable sponsored content programs, repeatable franchises, or branded editorial series that balance advertiser goals with audience trust and editorial integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to lead producers, editors, and cross\-functional creative teams while establishing workflows that increase velocity, quality, and clarity in fast\-paced environ

jobs.description:
This is a new position bringing digital marketing and communications in\-house after relying on an external agency. The person owns the day\-to\-day execution of AWHC's social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Facebook), email marketing, paid digital campaigns ($300K annual ad budget), website, and PR/earned media. They report to Max, who sets the strategic direction, and partner closely with the Development Director on email fundraising and donor communications.


### **About American Wild Horse Conservation**


American Wild Horse Conservation (AWHC) is a national nonprofit organization fighting to ensure that America's promise of lifelong freedom to wild horses and burros is fulfilled and the public lands they call home are preserved. Our public awareness and education campaigns, advocacy work, field work, and land conservation and habitat restoration projects aim to protect and conserve these iconic animals as an integral part of the landscape of the West.
### **Description**


Job Title: Communications Manager


Department: Marketing / Comms


Reports to: VP Marketing and Comms


Location: Remote


FLSA Classification: Exempt


Employment Type: Full\-time

 **About American Wild Horse Conservation**


STAY WILD. Keep Wild Horses and Burros Wild.


American Wild Horse Conservation (AWHC) is the nation’s leading nonprofit protecting wild horses and burros on public lands, and trusted wild horse conservation experts. Our purpose is to keep America’s promise to wild horses and burros. We honor and uphold their federal protections under the Wild Free Roaming Horses and Burros Act of 1971 and work to ensure humane, sustainable management through advocacy, public reform, and on the range conservation programs. Through collaboration with lawmakers, scientists, advocates and communities, AWHC is building a future where wild horses and burros can thrive on the western landscapes that define our national heritage. The ideal candidate combines creative instincts with a data\-driven mindset, thrives in a fast\-moving environment, and is energized by building something from the ground up. You don’t just post content, you understand why it matters, who it’s for, and whether it worked.

* Develop and execute the organization’s digital strategy to expand reach, grow the supporter base, increase engagement and advocacy participation, and drive donor revenue in partnership with the Marketing \& Communications and Development teams
* Ensure alignment between:
* Communications (awareness, storytelling, advocacy)
* Fundraising (donations, campaigns, partnerships, ambassadors)
* Grassroots engagement (petitions, advocacy actions, community building)
* Plan and execute multi\-channel campaigns from concept to delivery, ensuring messaging is consistent, on\-brand, and tied to measurable outcomes
* Coordinate with internal teams (conservation, law and policy, development) and external vendors to ensure timely delivery of all creative and channel\-led initiatives

* Actively engage with followers, partners, ambassadors, thought leaders, and allied organizations
* Monitor trends and opportunities related to wild horses, public lands, and conservation; lead social growth strategy
* Collaborate with content creators, photographers, and filmmakers as needed

 **Email Marketing \& Digital Fundraising**

* Own AWHC’s email marketing strategy and execution, including content planning, writing, segmentation, testing, and performance tracking
* Partner with the Development team to support fundraising campaigns, year\-end giving, monthly donor communications, and major initiatives
* Ensure email content aligns with storytelling, urgency, and donor journey strategy
* Maintain and optimize the website for usability, accessibility, SEO, and conversion performance
* Oversee landing pages and digital forms that support petitions, donations, and calls to action

* Test and refine paid strategies to grow the email list, increase donations, and expand awareness of wild horse issues
* Manage the paid digital budget with clear ROI tracking and regular optimization

jobs.title: Social & Digital Communications Manager
jobs.description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation's most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA\-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we're redefining what's possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We're proud to be recognized as one of Houston's fastest\-growing private companies and ranked \#116 in Healthcare \& Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025\.



Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we've created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.



At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission\-driven organization that's transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.



If you thrive in a fast\-moving, purpose\-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let's transform healthcare together.

* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor and benchmark performance against industry peers and identify opportunities to improve content resonance and audience growth.

Overview**The Problem**
===============


As Flock scales its brand presence across public sector and commercial markets, establishing a cohesive social media strategy and digital storytelling engine is essential to shaping public perception. Expanding our multi\-platform digital footprint requires creative and analytical leadership to build audience engagement, amplify product storytelling, and communicate our impact. You will design our social media playbook from the ground up, lead multi\-channel digital execution, and scale social media into a high\-impact brand engine.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Architect, launch, and execute a multi\-platform social media strategy across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging channels.
* Define and maintain Flock's social brand voice, creating content that builds awareness, trust, and engagement across public sector and commercial audiences.
* Oversee daily channel operations, including publishing schedules, content calendars, real\-time brand engagement, and crisis communication nuances.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Brand, Creative, Content, Communications, and Product Marketing teams to amplify major campaigns and product launches.
* Establish social analytics dashboards, track key performance indicators, and scale a dedicated social media team as the function grows.

**What This Role is Not**
=========================


* This isn't a purely high\-level strategy position, you will actively manage day\-to\-day channel operations, real\-time publishing, and content execution.
* This is not a specialized corporate communications or PR role, your core focus centers on multi\-platform social media growth, channel engagement, and digital storytelling.
* This isn't an isolated creative function, you will partner daily across Brand, Marketing, Sales, and Executive leadership while relying on analytics to guide strategy.

**What You Bring**
==================


* Extensive experience building, executing, and scaling social media strategy within high\-growth technology, civic\-tech, or mission\-driven organizations.
* Demonstrated track record of expanding social channel audiences and driving engagement across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
* Practical capability to balance creative campaign development with quantitative analytics, social listening, and performance measurement tools.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with experience advising executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders on digital brand strategy.
* Proven ability to navigate sensitive conversations and online communication with professional judgment and nuance.

**Compensation**
================


In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and $250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.


**Why Flock**
=============


Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.


Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.


Building the impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.


On compensation: we pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.


One last thing: all legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.


Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Senior Manager - State Government Relations and Public Affairs
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About Covista**  

  

Covista is America's largest healthcare educator, serving more than 97,000 students and supported by a community of 385,000 alumni across five accredited institutions. Through personalized, tech\-enabled education powered by 10,000 faculty and colleagues, Covista expands access to healthcare careers and addresses the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage at scale. Covista is the parent company of American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University.  

  

Our colleagues come from a wide range of backgrounds, business, academia, healthcare, government and nonprofits, and are part of a culture where doing exceptional work and making a meaningful difference for students and society aren't separate goals—they're one and the same. This means creating an environment where colleagues can develop new skills, build careers that match their ambitions and see the tangible impact of their work on healthcare education and workforce development. Colleagues who deliver results and embrace new tools to work smarter are valued for their contributions. But what makes working at Covista distinctive is our impact. Our faculty and colleagues don't just support healthcare education—they shape it. This isn't abstract purpose work. It's solving real problems for real people in real communities while advancing careers.  

  

We operate on a hybrid schedule with four in\-office days per week (Monday–Thursday). This approach enhances creativity, innovation, communication, and relationship\-building, fostering a dynamic and collaborative work environment.  

  

For more information, visit covista.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.  



  

  

**Job Description**  

Opportunity at a Glance

  

This role sits within Covista's Corporate Affairs team and reports to the Director, State Government Relations \& Public Affairs. You'll serve as Covista's embedded government relations presence across your region: the person who understands the political terrain, owns the state and local relationships, and ensures that Covista's institutions can operate successfully in the legislative and regulatory environment around them.


This is a field role. You'll be based in the Western US (CA, AZ, NV, UT) or Midwestern US (MN, IA, IL, IN ,MI, OH, MO), present in state capitols when it matters, and closely connected to the institutional leaders, healthcare system partners, contract lobbyists, and policymakers whose decisions shape our institutions' ability to grow and to serve students. You won't wait for legislation to occur to activate, because you'll be building relationships and shaping the political conditions long before that moment arrives. As part of an integrated Government Relations and Public Affairs function, you'll bring public affairs sensibility to the work as well: connecting policy engagement to the healthcare workforce story Covista is positioned to tell and ensuring that state\-level success stories reach the audiences who need to hear them.  

  

Responsibilities:


Regional Legislative and Regulatory Engagement

* Monitor and track legislative sessions, regulatory proceedings, and executive agency actions across all states in your region; ensure no significant development reaches leadership as a surprise
* Develop and maintain proactive relationships with state legislators, legislative staff, governors' offices, and state agencies in priority markets — building political goodwill before it is needed, not only in response to threats
* Identify and pursue opportunities for Covista to engage proactively in state policy conversations — through testimony, coalition participation, or direct stakeholder outreach — that advance our position as a credible healthcare workforce partner
* Translate state policy developments into clear, timely intelligence for the Director of State Government Relations, institutional leaders, and segment leadership making decisions about campus operations, program access, and market entry

jobs.description:
Director, Communications


R Street Institute


Washington, D.C.


The R Street Institute—a free\-market think tank headquartered in Washington, D.C. and with staff located across the country—seeks a collaborative Communications Director. If you are the right fit, you will report to the Senior Director of Communications. If you want to join a mission\-driven organization and work toward pragmatic policy solutions, this may be the opportunity for you!


Your typical day at R Street may include leading media relations and short\-form editorial operations for the organization, supporting an executive team member on commentary or remarks for an event, or working with the team to identify and cultivate new media channels, all while ensuring that the organization’s voice is clear, credible, and consistently represented across public platforms. This role manages a team of communications professionals responsible for media engagement, short\-form editorial content, and proactive outreach to journalists and opinion editors.


Working closely with the Senior Director of Communications, this person will help design and implement strategies that amplify R Street’s research, strengthen relationships with media partners, and position the organization as a trusted voice in public policy conversations. This person will also play a key role in staff development, workflow improvement, and coordination across Communications, Policy, and External Affairs functions to advance R Street’s visibility and mission. This role will serve as part of the communications department.

**Other Aspects of Your Role**

* Partner with the Senior Director to design and execute media and editorial strategies aligned with organizational goals, including brand strategy and executive thought leadership.
* Anticipate how AI is disrupting traditional product\-centric messaging, and build a communications strategy suited to a world where discovery, trust, and attention work differently than they did five years ago.
* Build audience\-first communications strategies rather than product\-first messaging—starting from who we're trying to reach and working backward to the right channels, formats, and moments.
* Oversee planning and execution of R Street’s press outreach, op\-eds, short\-form commentary, and editorial calendars in order to amplify R Street’s brand presence in key external channels, including major media outlets, newsletters, and opinion venues.
* Collaborate with the government affairs teams to ensure communications align with policy and legislative priorities.
* Support the executive team with key thought leadership pieces, speeches, media, and external affairs.
* Maintain and deepen relationships with journalists, producers, and editors; ensure consistent and proactive media engagement.
* Oversee the editing and publication of opinion and short\-form commentary for the RSI website, ensuring quality, timeliness, and adherence to organizational voice.
* Approve key communications outputs, including external newsletters, advisories, and high\-impact press releases.
* Track and report on media outcomes and engagement to inform communications planning.
* Remain vigilant against ninja infiltrations

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong relationships with journalists, editors, new media influencers, and other communications professionals.
* The ability to lead and manage multiple communications departments and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
* A good writer who has excellent attention to detail to ensure media content is accurate, timely, and impactful
* Sound decision\-making ability in a fast\-paced media and organizational environment.
* No particular educational background required—a proven record of achieving results is far more meaningful than credentials
* Support for R Street’s passion for free markets and limited, effective government
* A sense of humor and a desire to grow within a multifaceted organization


The R Street Institute consistently offers pragmatic, real solutions that foster American innovation, bolster competition, and safeguard individual liberty—all with the understanding that life in a democratic society sometimes requires compromises that don’t necessarily represent first, best solutions. We focus on deep scholarship and pragmatic policy solutions that many groups tend to neglect. Our goal is to publish timely, relevant research and analysis that advances a market\-oriented society and limited, effective government. To that end, our motto is “Free Markets. Real Solutions.” Read more about our mission and impact .

 **Workplace**


Candidates located in the Washington D.C area are preferred, however we will consider excellent candidates outside of D.C. with the understanding significant travel may be required.


We offer a flexible working arrangement. This is a full\-time position that can either work the majority of the week in our D.C. office or be fully remote.


Occasional travel may be required for events and conferences.

**Compensation, Benefits, and Perks**


R Street strives to offer a compensation and benefits package that is competitive, transparent, and supportive of employee well\-being. The salary range for this position is $115,000\-$135,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to this competitive salary, we provide the following:

* Unlimited paid time off, including all federal holidays, the day after Thanksgiving, and two weeks holiday closure in December

Job Opening: Communications Director

**Job Description**
-------------------


TARS, Inc., a premier national student organization affiliated with the Republican Party, is excited to announce a vacancy for a diligent and strategic Communications Director. We are seeking an innovative professional who is adept at delivering influential messages across diverse channels. This full\-time position offers a unique opportunity to lead and influence the communications landscape in support of our mission.


The ideal candidate will oversee all internal and external communications for TARS, Inc., ensuring its message is consistent and engaging.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* Develop and implement comprehensive communication strategies that align with the organization’s objectives.
* Lead the creation of all forms of media, including press releases, digital media, newsletters, and official statements.
* Manage the communications team to ensure high productivity and timely delivery of materials.
* Maintain open lines of communication with media outlets, and oversee the execution of media campaigns and interviews.
* Collaborate with other leaders within the organization to craft and refine messaging to support various policy positions and initiatives.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of communication strategies, adjusting plans as necessary to achieve desired outcomes.
* Represent the organization at public events and serve as the official spokesperson when designated.
* Maintain a crisis communications plan and lead the response to any public relations issues.
* Guide the digital marketing team in enhancing the organization’s online presence and audience engagement.
* Coordinate with political campaigns and party organizations to ensure consistency and strategic alignment of messages.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations affecting organizational communications.
* Foster an environment of innovation within the communications department to leverage emerging technologies and strategies.
* Educate and train leaders and members on public speaking, public relations best practices, and media interaction.
* Manage the annual communications budget and ensure effective use of resources.
* Regular review and update of organizational communications policies and guidelines.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related field preferred.
* Experience in a communications role, preferably within a political or nonprofit sector. Preference for those who also have some poitical experience.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Deep understanding of the media landscape and established media relations.
* Strong experience in strategic communications planning and execution across multiple platforms.
* Ability to perform well under pressure and manage crisis communication effectively.
* Demonstrated skill in digital marketing, including content creation and social media management.
* Highly skilled in project management and organizational leadership.
* Adept in using modern communication tools and platforms.
* Experienced in budget development and fiscal management.
* Knowledgeable about current political issues, with a firm grasp of conservative ideology.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.
* Commitment to the mission and values of TARS, Inc., and a clear understanding of its goals.
* Legal right to work in the United States without sponsorship.


Preference for candidates located in either the Washington, DC or Tri\-Cities (TN) areas, however fully remote candidates will be considered. This position will require some travel.

jobs.title: Director of Partnerships
jobs.description:
**About Breakthrough Discoveries**


Breakthrough Discoveries is a lean, high\-impact nonprofit dedicated to changing the trajectory of bipolar disorder research. We believe that by bridging the gap between innovative scientific inquiry and patient\-centered care, we can accelerate the next generation of interventions and create a world where all people with bipolar disorder thrive. We prioritize agility, transparency, and a steadfast focus on our mission.


**About the Director of Partnerships position**


We are looking for a dynamic Director of Partnerships to build and lead the fundraising engine that will fuel Breakthrough Discoveries' growth and drive innovation for mental health research. This role isn't just about closing gifts; it's about designing a development program from the ground up for a lean, mission\-driven organization. You will own the full arc of fundraising and partnership development strategy \- from pipeline to portfolio to stewardship \- ensuring our scientific partners have the resources they need to move fast and think big.


You will serve as a foundational member of our leadership team, shaping how we engage donors, build relationships, and scale impact. We expect you to be an exceptional leader who can build something from very little, move with urgency, and bring others along with you.


**Director of Partnerships responsibilities are:**


* **Fundraising Strategy:** Design and drive a comprehensive development strategy aligned to Breakthrough Discoveries' mission and growth targets. Evaluate and refine approaches continuously to meet short\- and long\-range goals.
* **Major Gifts:** Cultivate and manage an active portfolio of major and principal gift prospects. Engage directly in cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship across individuals, foundations, and corporations.
* **Pipeline Architecture:** Build a sustainable pipeline through organic inbound leads, prospect research, data analytics, community connection, and strategic outreach. Create the systems and processes that make development repeatable and scalable.
* **Donor Relations:** Lead a comprehensive stewardship program that deepens donor connection to Breakthrough Discoveries' work. Design acknowledgment processes and engagement strategies that recognize personal motivation and maximize long\-term donor potential.
* **Community:** Build community with change\-makers in bipolar research. Lead the development of high\-profile events to celebrate the progress in bipolar research. Work to develop action\-oriented strategy across the community of mental health funders.
* **Team and Infrastructure:** Select and implement software and tools to support development operations. Build toward an eventual development team.
* **Board and Leadership Engagement:** Build strong working relationships with board, advisory, and organizational leaders. Coordinate fundraising efforts to support the organizational vision and shape a compelling philanthropic case for support.
* **Compliance and Stewardship:** Coordinate with support teams to ensure regulatory and ethical compliance. Represent the organization at internal and external events.

**Who are You:**


* **A Builder:** You thrive in early\-stage environments. You see a blank slate and instinctively know how to construct something durable.
* **A Relationship Architect:** You understand that major philanthropy is built on trust, and you have the patience and presence to earn it.
* **Mission\-Aligned:** You have a genuine interest in scientific advancement and empathy for the community living with bipolar disorder.
* **Science Savvy:** You enjoy talking and learning about the science and clinical care of bipolar disorder and understand the environment of scientists, clinicians, and people with lived experience.
* **An Entrepreneurial Leader:** You know how to do a lot with a little, and you bring others along without losing momentum.
* **A Strategic Executor:** You can hold the big picture and manage the details — moving fluidly between vision and implementation.
* **Remote Native:** You are an expert at digital collaboration and can create meaningful connection from any distance.

**Director of Development requirements are:**


* 10\+ years of progressive fundraising experience, with a demonstrated track record in major gifts and campaign leadership, ideally within a scientific or health\-focused nonprofit environment.
* Solid experience across the full development function, including major and principal gifts, annual giving, corporate and foundation relations, stewardship, and donor communications.
* Strong practical knowledge of fundraising metrics, portfolio analytics, and performance tracking to inform strategy and report progress against goals.
* Working experience with CRM platforms and fundraising software; comfort adopting and onboarding new tools to support a growing development operation.
* Ability to understand and break down complex scientific and clinical jargon and speak to scientists and non\-scientists alike about the value of research.
* Exceptional organizational and leadership abilities, with experience managing or building teams and setting individual and collective fundraising goals.
* Outstanding communication and relationship skills, with the ability to engage credibly and warmly with donors, board members, scientific leaders, and internal colleagues at all levels.
* Familiarity with nonprofit legal and ethical guidelines governing fundraising, donor intent, fund stewardship, and gift acceptance policies.

**A Note on Location \& Work Eligibility:** To be considered for this role, you must currently reside in the U.S. and possess valid, ongoing work authorization that does not require company sponsorship.
